annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously states that a client SHOULD include the Last-Modified header in non-subrange cache validation requests (i.e., If-Modified-Since) when the origin server has provided only a Last-Modified value (and no entity-tag). The terms used are clear and the context (previous and next clauses) clarifies the meaning of 'non-subrange' and 'only a Last-Modified value'. No alternative materially different implementation behaviours or missing constraints are evident.
